title: Network modeling of sporadic colorectal cancer reveals the importance of off-target effects of Cyclooxygenase inhibitors.
authors: Gebhart, Anthony R; Berns, Manon M M; Snoeys, Jan; Elassaiss-Schaap, Jeroen; de Lange, Elizabeth C M
one_liner_zh: 该文用布尔网络模型研究COX抑制剂靶点对结直肠癌增殖凋亡的影响，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cyclooxygenase (COX) inhibitors (COXIBs) have shown preventive and therapeutic potential for colorectal cancer (CRC). In addition to inhibiting COX, approved COXIBs also target COX-independent pathways, including NF-kappaB and AKT. We evaluated how inhibition of various COXIB targets affects cell proliferation and apoptosis using a Boolean model incorporating the effect of several genetic mutations linked to CRC. The mutations activate two positive feedback loops and cause increased cell proliferation and survival. When simulating loss of function of APC, proliferation and apoptosis can be restored to healthy rates by inhibiting COX2. In simulations reflecting other genetic mutations, none of the investigated targets restore apoptosis and proliferation is reduced by inhibiting AKT or NF-kappaB, but not by any of the other COX targets tested. These results show that the off-target effects of COXIBs are crucial for their efficacy in the treatment of sporadic CRC.
abstract_zh: 环氧化酶（COX）抑制剂（COXIBs）已显示出对结直肠癌（CRC）的预防和治疗潜力。除了抑制COX外，已批准的COXIBs还靶向COX非依赖性通路，包括NF-kappaB和AKT。我们利用一个布尔模型，该模型整合了与CRC相关的多种基因突变效应，评估了抑制不同COXIB靶点对细胞增殖和凋亡的影响。这些突变激活两个正反馈环路，导致细胞增殖增加和存活率提高。在模拟APC功能丧失时，通过抑制COX2可将增殖和凋亡恢复至健康水平。在反映其他基因突变的模拟中，所研究的靶点均未能恢复凋亡，而抑制AKT或NF-kappaB可减少增殖，但其他测试的COX靶点均无此效果。这些结果表明，COXIBs的脱靶效应对于其在散发性CRC治疗中的疗效至关重要。
